elements.text:
Demographics:
  • N=80 in Fold 1 (40 PD, 40 HC) — balanced
  • Full dataset: 166 subjects (93 PD, 73 HC)
  • H&Y severity: 19/14/7 (imbalanced → SMOTE)

Signal analysis:
  • PD subjects show higher CV in force signals
  • Irregular peak spacing visible in raw traces
  • Consistent with Yogev 2005 variability findings

Feature extraction:
  • TSFresh: ~750+ features per channel window
  • Manual: 15 interpretable features per channel
  • Combined feet gave richest feature set

  • [Combined feet better than single foot?]

elements.name: TextBox 11
elements.text:
Baseline Models:
  • TSFresh features + Random Forest (5-fold CV)
  • TSFresh features + SVM linear & RBF (5-fold CV)
  • Evaluation: Accuracy, F1, AUC, precision, recall

Mamba / SSM Models:
  • Input: raw VGRF time series (multivariate)
  • Window: 5s / 2.5s step (matched to TSFresh)
  • Architecture: bidirectional Mamba encoder
    → binary head (PD/HC)
    → severity head (H&Y 2/2.5/3)
  • Inspired by HARMamba (Li et al. 2024)
    and MedMamba (He et al. 2026)

Evaluation Strategy:
  • SMOTE applied on training folds only
  • Cross-cohort testing (train Ga+Si, test Ju)
  • Target: beat Naimi et al. 88% severity accuracy
